speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma. The combination of a growing, non-pigmented chest lesion in a heavy smoker with diabetes, alongside normal inflammatory markers and no systemic B-symptoms, strongly supports this diagnosis over melanoma or infection. I recommend a surgical excisional biopsy for definitive histopathological confirmation and margin control.
